summary: Best combination of profitability and cash backing is VRSN (F-score 9/9, gp_sector_pct 0.993, cfo $1.09B vs net income $826M), then CARG and MSM. I applied L3 by checking sector labels: several names carry labels that do not match the business (DPZ, FAST, MSM, AYI, CARG, CART, MSCI, MCO, HWM), so their sector percentiles and any 'new sector' claims need care. Names with live deal or event situations (RRC, CART, AAPL) or weak cash conversion (DORM, GRMN, ONC) are left out of the ranking.
